content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the missing handling of interrupts that are snatched by KVM (Kernel-based Virtual Machine) in the icp-opal interrupt handling code. As a result, interrupts could be lost, leading to the CPU being stuck with an elevated Control Program Priority Register (CPPR). The patch adds necessary checks to recover from KVM-latched interrupts and ensures that the return value from the `opal_int_eoi()` call is properly checked to enhance the robustness of interrupt processing.
